claims.text: Model scoring for time step 42 produced a raw predict proba score of 0.019788 and a calibrated probability of 0.030534, falling into the low risk band with alert set to false.
Features f53 and f59 pushed the score up; features f88, f18 and f106 pushed the score down.
Model health check for time step 42 reported status ok with a window recall of 0.842105 and 304 illicit transactions in window.

Typology matching identified a chain pattern with chain length 4 meeting the threshold of 4, with 1469 n_flagged, an observed illicit rate of 0.257318, baseline illicit rate of 0.115809, lift of 2.221913, and evidence direction raises_risk.
Neighborhood analysis found 1 in-neighbor which alerted, and 1 out-neighbor which did not alert.

Subgraph summary within radius 2 showed 4 nodes, 3 edges, density 0.25, focal in-degree 1, focal out-degree 1, max in-degree 1, max out-degree 1, 1 alerted node with share alerted 0.25, focal chain length 4, and wcc size 7140.

background.paraphrase: FinCEN guidance lists unusually complex series of transactions indicative of layering activity involving multiple accounts, banks, parties, and jurisdictions as general indicators of suspicious activity.
background.quote: • unusually complex series of transactions indicative of layering activity involving multiple accounts, banks, parties, jurisdictions;

background.paraphrase: FATF guidance discusses potential use of money mules and multiple layering of fiat funds prior to virtual asset purchases.
background.quote: In addition, multiple layering of the fiat funds was arranged prior to the VA purchase by mules.

limitations: The Elliptic dataset has no wallet addresses, names, amounts or dates, so none of these appear in this memo.
The model's recall collapsed after time step 43 (a dark-market shutdown), and the model-health check only detects such a collapse several steps later, so scores at later time steps may be unreliable.
Regulation retrieval is weak (hybrid hit@3 about 0.6 on a small test set): retrieved passages are leads for an analyst, not verified authorities, and text from the India document comes from OCR.
Scores are raw gradient-boosting outputs, not calibrated probabilities; the calibrated value shifts with the prevalence of illicit activity.
Structural patterns are resemblances only: Elliptic has no typology labels.
The model-health monitor uses labels with a 2-step lag and a 3-step window, so it cannot flag a collapse in its first steps. On this dataset it first flags at step 47.
This is a draft for a human analyst. It does not decide whether a report should be filed.
